title: object tag array iterated twice in handle_create
description: inbox.rs handle_create iterates object['tag'].as_array() twice: once at line 1036-1085 for Mention processing, and again at line 1088-1102 for FEP-e232 Link/quote processing. These could be a single pass through the tags array. Not a performance issue (tag arrays are small), but the second iteration block looks like it was added without noticing the first already had access to the same array. A single loop dispatching on tag type would be clearer.
